title: Siblings in Dressed-Up White Easter Attire, 1939 California Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
FADE PROOF
APR 21 1939
Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
270A
description: An outdoor full-length portrait of three siblings smartly dressed in bright spring or Easter attire standing on a manicured lawn. The older boy on the left wears an elegant all-white suit with wide lapels and matching white shoes. The youngest boy in the center sports a white sports coat over a polo shirt, dark shorts, striped socks, and sandals, smiling endearingly. The girl on the right wears a short-sleeved patterned dress with puff sleeves, a narrow belt, and curls styled with ribbons. Bare-branched trees and a clipped hedge fill the sunny backyard background.
